test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice**

This match is being watched today by more than thirty-three million people worldwide.

options.text: This match is watching more than thirty-three million people worldwide today.
More than thirty-three million people worldwide have been watching this match today.
More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.
Today more than thirty-three million people worldwide have watched this match.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question, we have to change the sentence into Active Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ is/am/are + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He is riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike is being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
 
 
• Here, in the given question 'are being watched' will be changed into 'are watching'. 
 
• 'By' will be removed.
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points, we find that the correct answer is Option 3. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ *More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.*
